title: GitHub repositories in an organization
description: Lists all repositories in a GitHub organization with visibility, archive state and activity signals.

outputs.name: archived
outputs.description: True when the repository is archived

template: SELECT name, full_name, visibility, archived, default_branch, pushed_at, stargazers_count FROM github.repos.repos WHERE org = '{{org}}';
notes: Unauthenticated calls see only public repositories and are heavily rate-limited; authenticate to see private and internal repositories the token can access. Results are paginated transparently by StackQL.
